findings.title: The pricing omits the signage promised in the summary

replies.rationale: No finding is blocking, so not_ready does not apply. One finding is major: scope:1 says the pricing omits the signage promised in the summary, which triggers ready_after_fixes under the guidance. The other finding, terms:1 (no validity period), is minor and does not change the outcome, though it is worth fixing alongside. The decision rests on scope:1 being resolved by adding the signage to the pricing or removing it from the summary. A person should confirm that fix before sign-off. No reviewer disagreements were reported.
